headline: Joe will never let you down
dek: A Complete and Total Endorsement for the RNC Chairman, who once named the President Statesman of the Year. Twice.

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: MAGA Warrior Joe Gruters, who has been with us from the very beginning, is running to continue as Chairman of the Republican National Committee. As Chairman, Joe turned the RNC into an efficient, focused, and powerful machine that will continue to empower the America First Agenda for many years to come.

As State Senator and Chairman of the Republican Party of Florida, Joe helped us deliver massive and historic Victories across the State, including my three BIG WINS in 2016, 2020, and 2024! Joe was the Chairman of Florida when I won that Great State by the Highest Vote Margin in History, as we then went on to win the 2024 Presidential Election. As Sarasota County Chairman, Joe named me Statesman of the Year in both 2012 and 2015 — The only person to ever win it two times!

Joe Gruters should return as Chairman of the RNC to continue to build our Party, and be a trusted partner as we MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN, and ensure Free and Fair Elections. Republicans everywhere should support him as he continues his mission at the RNC. Joe is 100% America First, the Grassroots LOVES him, and I know he will do an incredible job in 2028, and secure Great Success for Republicans all across our Country. Joe has my Complete and Total Endorsement — HE WILL NEVER LET YOU DOWN! President DONALD J. TRUMP

verification.note: Copied by the editor from Roll Call Factbase on 7 November 2026.

en: Joe Gruters has led the Republican National Committee with energy and discipline, and I am proud to support his bid to continue as Chairman.

Joe has been part of our movement from the start: in the Florida Senate, as chairman of the Republican Party of Florida, and now at the RNC. I believe he is the right person to build our party, support our candidates across the country and help ensure free and fair elections. He has my full endorsement.
fr: Joe Gruters a dirigé le Comité national républicain avec énergie et rigueur, et je suis fier de soutenir sa candidature à un nouveau mandat de président.

Joe accompagne notre mouvement depuis le début : au Sénat de Floride, à la tête du Parti républicain de Floride, puis au Comité national. Il est la bonne personne pour bâtir notre parti, soutenir nos candidats et contribuer à des élections libres et équitables. Il a mon plein soutien.

Salut les gaillards ! Joe, c’est un des nôtres depuis le début. Il a été chef du parti en Floride, et à Sarasota il m’a nommé homme d’État de l’année. Deux fois ! Le seul à l’avoir eu deux fois, c’est moi.
À la Bénichon, celui qui te ressert de la cuchaule, tu le gardes. Votez Joe.
en: Hey folks! Joe’s been one of ours from the start. He ran the party in Florida, and in Sarasota he named me Statesman of the Year. Twice! The only person ever to get it twice is me.
At the harvest festival, the man who serves you a second slice of saffron bread is a man you keep. Vote Joe.
notes: The cuchaule is Fribourg’s saffron brioche, eaten with Bénichon mustard at the autumn harvest festival.

fr: Joe Gruters, c’est un gone fidèle : là depuis le début, toujours. Il m’a nommé homme d’État de l’année deux fois. Le seul à l’avoir eu deux fois, c’est moi, notez-le.
Alors Joe, pour moi, c’est comme un bouchon qui ne change jamais sa carte : on y retourne les yeux fermés.
en: Joe Gruters is a loyal lad: there from the start, always. He named me Statesman of the Year twice. The only one ever to get it twice is me, write that down.
So to me, Joe is like a Lyon bistro that never changes its menu: you go back with your eyes closed.
